extra_vocab.en: to help something grow or develop over time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指委員會推出三項措施，來「促進」一個更公平的制度。foster 後面常接抽象名詞（trust、a culture、cooperation），語氣正式，常見於政策與簡報。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: foster 後面直接接抽象名詞當受詞（foster innovation），不接 to V；要說「鼓勵人去做某事」才用 encourage + 人 + to V。

example.en: A flexible schedule fosters creativity among our design staff.
example.zh: 彈性的工作時間能促進設計人員的創造力。

example.en: The new training program fostered stronger ties between regional offices.
example.zh: 新的訓練計畫促進了各區域辦公室之間更緊密的關係。

example.en: Fostering trust takes time, especially after a major restructuring.
example.zh: 培養信任需要時間，尤其是在大規模重組之後。

example.en: Managers should foster a culture of open communication.
example.zh: 主管應該培養開放溝通的文化。

example.en: Giving staff free time can foster innovation in the long run.
example.zh: 給員工自由時間，長期而言可以促進創新。

example.en: The joint workshop helped foster cooperation between sales and design.
example.zh: 這場聯合工作坊有助於促進業務與設計部門的合作。

example.en: The grant will foster growth in small local businesses.
example.zh: 這筆補助將促進當地小型企業的成長。

examples.en: Our mentoring program is designed to foster loyalty among new hires.
examples.zh: 我們的師徒計畫是為了培養新進員工的忠誠度。

examples.en: Thank you for helping us foster a positive working environment.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫助我們營造正向的工作環境。

examples.en: We must foster stronger relationships with our overseas partners.
examples.zh: 我們必須與海外夥伴培養更穩固的關係。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音有點像，但 faster 是 fast 的比較級「更快的」，不是動詞。

example.en: The faster delivery option costs an extra ten dollars.
example.zh: 較快的配送選項要多收十美元。

similar.diff: forge 強調「建立」關係或合約，多接 relationship、partnership；foster 強調讓某事慢慢發展。

example.en: The two firms forged a strong partnership last year.
example.zh: 這兩家公司去年建立了穩固的夥伴關係。

similar.diff: encourage 可接人再加 to V（encourage staff to speak up）；foster 只接抽象名詞。

example.en: We want to encourage employees to share ideas openly.
example.zh: 我們希望鼓勵員工公開分享想法。

example.en: Good managers nurture young talent within the company.
example.zh: 好的主管會在公司內培育年輕人才。

example.en: She worked hard to cultivate relationships with key clients.
example.zh: 她努力與重要客戶培養關係。

example.en: The campaign aims to promote healthy habits in the workplace.
example.zh: 這項活動的目標是在職場推廣健康習慣。

extra_vocab.zh: 投入度、參與度；約定；委任案
extra_vocab.en: the feeling of being interested and involved in something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇 engagement survey 指調查員工對工作的「投入度／敬業度」，是人資簡報的常用語。engagement 在多益也常指預先安排的約定或顧問委任案，要看上下文判斷。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「約定、委任案」時是可數名詞（a prior engagement）；表示「投入度」時通常不可數，不加 a。

example.en: Mr. Lee has two speaking engagements next month in Singapore.
example.zh: 李先生下個月在新加坡有兩場演講行程。

example.en: Higher employee engagement usually leads to lower turnover.
example.zh: 較高的員工敬業度通常會帶來較低的離職率。

example.en: Our social media team measures customer engagement every week.
example.zh: 我們的社群媒體團隊每週衡量顧客互動程度。

example.en: The engagement survey will be sent to all staff on Monday.
example.zh: 敬業度調查將在星期一寄給所有員工。

example.en: I cannot attend because of a prior engagement.
example.zh: 我因為先前已有約而無法出席。

examples.en: Low engagement among new hires worried the HR director.
examples.zh: 新進員工的低投入度讓人資主管很擔心。

examples.en: We improved engagement by involving staff in decision making.
examples.zh: 我們讓員工參與決策，藉此提高了投入度。

examples.en: Please accept my apologies; I have an engagement on that afternoon.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我那天下午已有約。

similar.diff: involvement 指「參與」某件事；engagement 還包含情感上的投入與熱忱。

example.en: Employee involvement in planning improved the final result.
example.zh: 員工參與規劃讓最後的成果更好。

similar.diff: commitment 強調承諾與全心付出；engagement 強調對工作的興趣與參與感。

example.en: Her commitment to the project impressed the whole team.
example.zh: 她對專案的投入讓整個團隊印象深刻。

example.en: Clear goals can raise motivation across the sales team.
example.zh: 明確的目標可以提高整個業務團隊的動力。

example.en: The bonus announcement boosted morale in the office.
example.zh: 獎金公告提升了辦公室的士氣。

example.en: High turnover is costly for a growing company.
example.zh: 高離職率對成長中的公司來說代價很高。

derived.link: engage 是詞幹，加 -ment 變成名詞，像 manage → management
engage + -ing，當形容詞「吸引人的」，像 interesting
dis-（不）+ engaged，不投入工作的，像 dislike、disagree

senses.en: the feeling of being interested and involved in your work

example.en: Regular feedback sessions raised team engagement across the whole department.
example.zh: 定期的回饋會議提高了整個部門的團隊投入度。

senses.en: an arrangement to be somewhere at a certain time
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 speaking、business 或前面加 prior，指行程上的安排。

example.en: The CEO has a speaking engagement in Osaka next Thursday.
example.zh: 執行長下週四在大阪有一場演講。

senses.en: a job or project that you are hired to do
senses.distinguish: 多用在顧問、會計、法律等專業服務，常見 consulting engagement。

example.en: The firm won a six-month consulting engagement with a local bank.
example.zh: 這家公司拿下了與當地銀行為期六個月的顧問案。

extra_vocab.en: not connected to the subject you are talking about
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指推薦信不可寫與職務無關的個人特質或話題；irrelevant 放在名詞 topics 後面修飾，語氣直接，用來劃定資料範圍。多益常見於面試、報告和審核情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: irrelevant 後面接 to（irrelevant to the role），不接 for 或 with；放在名詞後面時等於 topics that are irrelevant to the role。

example.en: Details irrelevant to the project should be removed from the report.
example.zh: 與專案無關的細節應該從報告中刪除。

example.en: His comment was completely irrelevant to the budget discussion.
example.zh: 他的意見和預算討論完全無關。

example.en: Please delete any irrelevant information from your resume before applying.
example.zh: 申請前請刪除履歷裡任何不相關的資訊。

examples.en: That point is irrelevant, so let's return to the main agenda.
examples.zh: 那一點無關，所以我們回到主要議程吧。

examples.en: Salary history is irrelevant when we evaluate candidates for this role.
examples.zh: 我們評估這個職位的應徵者時，薪資紀錄是無關的。

examples.en: The auditor flagged several irrelevant charges in the expense report.
examples.zh: 稽核人員標出了費用報告中幾筆不相關的費用。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像，但 irreverent 是「不敬的、不恭敬的」，和相關性無關。

example.en: His irreverent joke offended some of the senior managers.
example.zh: 他不敬的玩笑冒犯了幾位資深主管。

similar.diff: unrelated 指兩件事之間沒有關聯；irrelevant 強調對目前討論的主題沒有用處。

example.en: The two incidents are unrelated, according to the report.
example.zh: 根據報告，這兩起事件互不相關。

similar.diff: beside the point 是慣用語，較口語，意思是「離題、不是重點」。

example.en: Your concern is beside the point at this stage.
example.zh: 在這個階段，你的疑慮並不是重點。

example.en: Please include only pertinent details in the summary.
example.zh: 摘要中請只放入相關的細節。

example.en: This rule is applicable to all full-time staff.
example.zh: 這項規定適用於所有全職員工。

example.en: Remove unnecessary slides to keep the talk short.
example.zh: 刪掉不必要的投影片，讓報告簡短一點。

derived.link: relevant 是詞幹；加字首 ir-（不）變成 irrelevant，像 irregular、irresponsible
relevant 把 -t 改成 -ce 變名詞，像 important → importance
ir- + relevance，「沒有相關性」，像 irregularity

extra_vocab.zh: 以電子方式、透過電子系統
extra_vocab.en: by using computers or other electronic systems
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指在職證明可透過 HR 入口網站「以電子方式」申請，不必再用紙本。多益常見於 submit、send、sign electronically，表示線上辦理的作業流程。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: electronically 常放在動詞或受詞後修飾動作（request it electronically）；也可放在過去分詞前，如 electronically signed form。

example.en: You may submit your expense report electronically through the portal.
example.zh: 你可以透過入口網站以電子方式提交費用報告。

example.en: Contracts can be signed electronically from any device.
example.zh: 合約可以在任何裝置上以電子方式簽署。

example.en: All client records are stored electronically for easy access.
example.zh: 所有客戶紀錄都以電子形式儲存，方便調閱。

example.en: Most taxpayers now file electronically instead of by mail.
example.zh: 現在大多數納稅人都以電子方式申報，而不是郵寄。

examples.en: Pay slips will be delivered electronically starting next month.
examples.zh: 從下個月開始，薪資單將以電子方式寄送。

examples.en: Please return the signed form electronically by noon on Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五中午前以電子方式回傳簽署好的表格。

examples.en: Meeting minutes will be shared electronically with all attendees.
examples.zh: 會議紀錄將以電子方式分享給所有與會者。

confusable.diff: 和電力、電流有關；electronically 則和電子、數位系統有關。

example.en: The machine runs electrically, so it needs a power outlet.
example.zh: 這台機器靠電力運轉，所以需要插座。

similar.diff: online 指透過網路進行；electronically 範圍更廣，包含電子郵件、電子簽名和各種系統。

example.en: You can complete the form online in five minutes.
example.zh: 你可以在五分鐘內線上填完這份表格。

similar.diff: digitally 強調資料是數位格式；electronically 強調透過電子方式處理。

example.en: The archive was scanned and stored digitally.
example.zh: 這批檔案被掃描並以數位方式儲存。

example.en: Employees can view pay slips on the HR portal.
example.zh: 員工可以在人資入口網站上查看薪資單。

example.en: We are moving toward a paperless office this year.
example.zh: 我們今年正朝無紙辦公室邁進。

derived.link: electric 是詞幹，表示和「電」有關
electric + -ity，變成名詞「電」，像 active → activity
electr- + -onic，與電子裝置有關的，像 electronic mail（電子郵件）
electronic + -s，表示「電子類產品或學科」，像 economics

extra_vocab.en: the act of joining a course, program, or school
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指領導力工作坊的報名手續，以前用紙本表單，現在全部線上完成。多益常見於課程、福利方案（open enrollment）和學校人數的說明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 對應的動詞是 enroll，後面常接 in：enroll in a course；enrollment 這個拼法是美式，英式拼成 enrolment。

example.en: Enrollments for the spring workshops increased by thirty percent.
example.zh: 春季工作坊的報名人數增加了三成。

example.en: Enrollment in the safety course is required for all new staff.
example.zh: 所有新進員工都必須報名參加安全課程。

example.en: Open enrollment for health insurance begins on November first.
example.zh: 健保方案的開放登記期從十一月一日開始。

example.en: Please fill out the enrollment form and return it to HR.
example.zh: 請填寫報名表並交回人資部門。

example.en: The enrollment deadline for the evening class is next Friday.
example.zh: 夜間課程的報名截止日是下週五。

examples.en: Thank you for your enrollment; your confirmation is attached.
examples.zh: 謝謝您的報名，確認信已附上。

examples.en: Parents can complete their child's enrollment on the school website.
examples.zh: 家長可以在學校網站上完成孩子的註冊。

examples.en: Falling enrollment may force us to cancel the advanced course.
examples.zh: 報名人數下滑可能迫使我們取消進階課程。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭相近，但 employment 是「僱用、就業」，不是報名。

example.en: Proof of employment is required for the loan application.
example.zh: 申請貸款需要在職證明。

similar.diff: registration 是範圍較廣的登記（活動、車輛、帳號）；enrollment 偏課程、學校或方案。

example.en: Online registration closes at five o'clock on Friday.
example.zh: 線上登記在星期五下午五點截止。

similar.diff: sign-up 比較口語，常指報名表或報名這個動作；enrollment 較正式。

example.en: The sign-up sheet for the workshop is on the notice board.
example.zh: 工作坊的報名表貼在布告欄上。

example.en: The company will pay the tuition for approved courses.
example.zh: 公司會支付核准課程的學費。

example.en: The training curriculum covers leadership and communication skills.
example.zh: 這份訓練課程涵蓋領導與溝通技巧。

example.en: Each participant will receive a certificate after the workshop.
example.zh: 每位參加者在工作坊結束後都會拿到證書。

derived.link: enroll 是詞幹，加 -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement

senses.en: the act of joining a course or program

example.en: Enrollment in the leadership program closes at the end of the month.
example.zh: 領導力方案的報名在月底截止。

senses.en: the number of people who have joined a course or school
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 total、falling、rising 這類字，談的是人數而不是手續。

example.en: Total enrollment at the training center reached five hundred this year.
example.zh: 今年訓練中心的註冊總人數達到五百人。
